## History

As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's school routines resumed following a local concert, Susan was among the friends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walked to school with on her thirteenth birthday. She then joined a story club established by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) alongside their other friends.
